title: MachineCheck
description: A health check definition for a Fly Machine.

port.description: Port to run the health check against.

interval.description: How often to run the check (e.g., 10s, 1m).

timeout.description: Maximum time to wait for the check to respond.

grace_period.description: Time to wait after Machine start before running checks.

method.description: HTTP method for http-type checks. Defaults to GET.
